findings.title: A regenerated receipt falsely inherits the previous receipt archive success
findings.evidence: Local Vitest regression uses real signed invoice, real receipt signatures and lean profile; mocked encrypted archive observes exactly one write for receipt A. After Clear invoice binding, revalidate and sign one second later, signature B differs but UI displays disabled Receipt archived for B. Desired assertion fails.
findings.impact: The latest signed receipt is absent from encrypted history while UI claims success and prevents saving it. A late completion for A can also mark B done because invalidation does not change archive generation.
findings.remediation: Bind archive state and asynchronous completion to exact receipt signature/identity. Clear archive state and increment archive generation when binding or receipt invalidates or is replaced. Preserve completed writes to the old receipt without attributing them to the new one.
findings.duplicate_search: No matching existing component archive-state finding found in docs/reviews or relevant tests.

existing_fixed_findings.title: Same-chain manifest reload exposes a stale previous manifest
existing_fixed_findings.evidence: useManifest state is keyed only by chainId on main; A→undefined→A returns the prior A result while the new service load is pending. Candidate scopes results to useMemo({chainId,services}). Existing Disclosure.manifest.test.tsx covers this correction.

existing_fixed_findings.title: Hiding the page does not cancel a pending pasted/image QR import on main
existing_fixed_findings.evidence: Main visible() omits document visibility and visibilityChanged aborts only camera work; pending pasted/image callbacks can still complete after hiding. Candidate checks visibility, aborts local imports and verifies before deliver. Existing CameraImporter.visibility.test.tsx covers it.
